# pr-1558: gh-1555 [GOAL] Session JSONL grows unboundedly past the 2 GiB full-open backstop legacy full-open call sites (picker, resume fallback, trajectory, subagent preview) make the session unopenable ## Description Closes #1555 ## gh-1555 W1 — Lazy/windowed-everywhere reads (first shippable slice) ### What changed Migrated the legacy full-open call sites (ticket mechanism d1–d7) to windowed opens so a session past the 2 GiB gh-1073 backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path. The TUI picker (the incident's exact failure path), `/resume`, boot name-resolution, subagent transcript preview, and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver now open windowed; name lookups page via `resolveSessionName()`. The `_loadSession` marathon fallback's full open (which refused past 2 GiB — the incident's broken rescue) is replaced by proceeding with the tail-anchored windowed session. Trajectory `view/cost/inspect` materialize the branch via the new `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident()` → `WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder()` (sequential bounded-block forward scan, no full-open refusal); `tail` polls stay windowed. ### Key decisions - `loadAllOlder()` (sequential strips from file head, one splice) chosen over reusing `growOlderUntil` — the boundary-walk's doubling strips + per-strip record cap amplified read/parse ~13× over a whole file (30k-record bench: 9.6s vs 0.85s full open). - `_indexChunk` now block-prepends (`insertAll`) instead of per-record `insert(0)` — suspended-eviction walks had made it O(n²). - Subagent registry source no longer hard-casts `_repo as JsonlSessionRepo`; foreign repos degrade to an empty registry instead of crashing. - Degradation contract preserved (F3 NEG): a genuinely corrupt session still reports inline through the picker catch; only the refusal-producing full open is gone. ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/cli/oversize_session_open_test.dart test/session/session_tree_test.dart dart test test/cli/sessions_picker_test.dart test/cli/trajectory_cli_test.dart ``` Regression runs: `test/session` (314), `test/trajectory` (197), `test/agent`+`test/hub` (548), `test/cli` (3529) all green; trajectory perf gate within budget (97 MB real CLI path, parse 791 ms / total 5.4 s). `dart analyze` clean on all touched files. ### Not in this slice (follow-ups) AC3a streaming trajectory export (exporters still snapshot-based), W2 rotation activation, W3 write-side caps (owner-call, opt-in), picker "too large to preview" badge UI, E2E/nightly oversize fixtures (AC8). loadAllOlder: bounded blocks, one splice] W --> N[resolveSessionName
paged name lookup] TL[fa trajectory tail] --> W end ```

# Pull Request Information - **PR #**: 1558 - **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1558 - **Title**: gh-1555 [GOAL] Session JSONL grows unboundedly past the 2 GiB full-open backstop legacy full-open call sites (picker, resume fallback, trajectory, subagent preview) make the session unopenable - **Author**: ai-teammate - **Branch**: `ai/gh-1555` → `main` - **State**: open - **Files Changed**: 14 - **Additions**: +946 - **Deletions**: -54 - **Created**: 2026-10-11T21:05:18Z - **Updated**: 2026-10-13T21:20:11Z ## PR Description Closes #1555 ## gh-1555 W1 — Lazy/windowed-everywhere reads (first shippable slice) ### What changed Migrated the legacy full-open call sites (ticket mechanism d1–d7) to windowed opens so a session past the 2 GiB gh-1073 backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path. The TUI picker (the incident's exact failure path), `/resume`, boot name-resolution, subagent transcript preview, and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver now open windowed; name lookups page via `resolveSessionName()`. The `_loadSession` marathon fallback's full open (which refused past 2 GiB — the incident's broken rescue) is replaced by proceeding with the tail-anchored windowed session. Trajectory `view/cost/inspect` materialize the branch via the new `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident()` → `WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder()` (sequential bounded-block forward scan, no full-open refusal); `tail` polls stay windowed. ### Key decisions - `loadAllOlder()` (sequential strips from file head, one splice) chosen over reusing `growOlderUntil` — the boundary-walk's doubling strips + per-strip record cap amplified read/parse ~13× over a whole file (30k-record bench: 9.6s vs 0.85s full open). - `_indexChunk` now block-prepends (`insertAll`) instead of per-record `insert(0)` — suspended-eviction walks had made it O(n²). - Subagent registry source no longer hard-casts `_repo as JsonlSessionRepo`; foreign repos degrade to an empty registry instead of crashing. - Degradation contract preserved (F3 NEG): a genuinely corrupt session still reports inline through the picker catch; only the refusal-producing full open is gone. ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/cli/oversize_session_open_test.dart test/session/session_tree_test.dart dart test test/cli/sessions_picker_test.dart test/cli/trajectory_cli_test.dart ``` Regression runs: `test/session` (314), `test/trajectory` (197), `test/agent`+`test/hub` (548), `test/cli` (3529) all green; trajectory perf gate within budget (97 MB real CLI path, parse 791 ms / total 5.4 s). `dart analyze` clean on all touched files. ### Not in this slice (follow-ups) AC3a streaming trajectory export (exporters still snapshot-based), W2 rotation activation, W3 write-side caps (owner-call, opt-in), picker "too large to preview" badge UI, E2E/nightly oversize fixtures (AC8). Known pre-existing, reproduced on unmodified main: `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts the VM at teardown (`malloc_consolidate(): unaligned fastbin chunk`) and kills whole-directory `dart test` runs that include it — run it in isolation.

loadAllOlder: bounded blocks, one splice] W --> N[resolveSessionName
paged name lookup] TL[fa trajectory tail] --> W end ```

# pr-1558: gh-1555 [GOAL] Session JSONL grows unboundedly past the 2 GiB full-open backstop legacy full-open call sites (picker, resume fallback, trajectory, subagent preview) make the session unopenable ## Description Closes #1555 ## gh-1555 W1 — Lazy/windowed-everywhere reads (first shippable slice) ### What changed Migrated the legacy full-open call sites (ticket mechanism d1–d7) to windowed opens so a session past the 2 GiB gh-1073 backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path. The TUI picker (the incident's exact failure path), `/resume`, boot name-resolution, subagent transcript preview, and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver now open windowed; name lookups page via `resolveSessionName()`. The `_loadSession` marathon fallback's full open (which refused past 2 GiB — the incident's broken rescue) is replaced by proceeding with the tail-anchored windowed session. Trajectory `view/cost/inspect` materialize the branch via the new `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident()` → `WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder()` (sequential bounded-block forward scan, no full-open refusal); `tail` polls stay windowed. ### Key decisions - `loadAllOlder()` (sequential strips from file head, one splice) chosen over reusing `growOlderUntil` — the boundary-walk's doubling strips + per-strip record cap amplified read/parse ~13× over a whole file (30k-record bench: 9.6s vs 0.85s full open). - `_indexChunk` now block-prepends (`insertAll`) instead of per-record `insert(0)` — suspended-eviction walks had made it O(n²). - Subagent registry source no longer hard-casts `_repo as JsonlSessionRepo`; foreign repos degrade to an empty registry instead of crashing. - Degradation contract preserved (F3 NEG): a genuinely corrupt session still reports inline through the picker catch; only the refusal-producing full open is gone. ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/cli/oversize_session_open_test.dart test/session/session_tree_test.dart dart test test/cli/sessions_picker_test.dart test/cli/trajectory_cli_test.dart ``` Regression runs: `test/session` (314), `test/trajectory` (197), `test/agent`+`test/hub` (548), `test/cli` (3529) all green; trajectory perf gate within budget (97 MB real CLI path, parse 791 ms / total 5.4 s). `dart analyze` clean on all touched files. ### Not in this slice (follow-ups) AC3a streaming trajectory export (exporters still snapshot-based), W2 rotation activation, W3 write-side caps (owner-call, opt-in), picker "too large to preview" badge UI, E2E/nightly oversize fixtures (AC8). loadAllOlder: bounded blocks, one splice] W --> N[resolveSessionName
paged name lookup] TL[fa trajectory tail] --> W end ```

# pr-1558: gh-1555 [GOAL] Session JSONL grows unboundedly past the 2 GiB full-open backstop legacy full-open call sites (picker, resume fallback, trajectory, subagent preview) make the session unopenable ## Description Closes #1555 ## gh-1555 W1 — Lazy/windowed-everywhere reads (first shippable slice) ### What changed Migrated the legacy full-open call sites (ticket mechanism d1–d7) to windowed opens so a session past the 2 GiB gh-1073 backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path. loadAllOlder: bounded blocks, one splice] W --> N[resolveSessionName
paged name lookup] TL[fa trajectory tail] --> W end ```

  treats that exact message as transparent, so the turn's partial-content
  window (gh-1577) survives a nudged retry. Headless: the empty-reply nudge
  budget rises to `AgentCliConfig.headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2 — the
  session ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive
  keeps the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics), and a run that still settles
  empty prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a
  distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0.

- gh-1577: an empty assistant completion after partial content (assistant
  text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is a
  bounded-retry provider hiccup — up to `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3)
  re-streams with exponential backoff (`emptyHiccupBaseDelay`,
  `emptyHiccupMaxBackoff`, both threaded through the `Agent` facade,
  `AgentWiringSpec`, and the CLI config), and exhaustion ends the run with
  a loud `StopReason.error` (headless exit 1, interactive error + prompt)
  instead of the silent exit-0 settle that killed the gh-1577 trials.

  `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS` / `--timer`/`--deadline` / `/timer` write one
  session clock, the per-turn context carries a `time-left:` line while
  armed, and one-shot system notices steer wrap-up at ~50%, T-3min
  (drain background jobs), and T-30s; absent deadline = byte-for-byte
  today's behavior.

- gh-1522: tag-sourced versions — the git tag is the single source of
  truth. The release-bot file bumps are retired: cutting a release = a
  tag + GitHub Release (zero commits to main, zero file mutations).
  Both pubspecs carry the fixed `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (CI guards

# Pull Request Information - **PR #**: 1558 - **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1558 - **Title**: gh-1555 [GOAL] Session JSONL grows unboundedly past the 2 GiB full-open backstop legacy full-open call sites (picker, resume fallback, trajectory, subagent preview) make the session unopenable - **Author**: ai-teammate - **Branch**: `ai/gh-1555` → `main` - **State**: open - **Files Changed**: 14 - **Additions**: +946 - **Deletions**: -54 - **Created**: 2026-10-11T21:05:18Z - **Updated**: 2026-10-13T21:20:11Z ## PR Description Closes #1555 ## gh-1555 W1 — Lazy/windowed-everywhere reads (first shippable slice) ### What changed Migrated the legacy full-open call sites (ticket mechanism d1–d7) to windowed opens so a session past the 2 GiB gh-1073 backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path. The TUI picker (the incident's exact failure path), `/resume`, boot name-resolution, subagent transcript preview, and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver now open windowed; name lookups page via `resolveSessionName()`. The `_loadSession` marathon fallback's full open (which refused past 2 GiB — the incident's broken rescue) is replaced by proceeding with the tail-anchored windowed session. Trajectory `view/cost/inspect` materialize the branch via the new `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident()` → `WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder()` (sequential bounded-block forward scan, no full-open refusal); `tail` polls stay windowed. ### Key decisions - `loadAllOlder()` (sequential strips from file head, one splice) chosen over reusing `growOlderUntil` — the boundary-walk's doubling strips + per-strip record cap amplified read/parse ~13× over a whole file (30k-record bench: 9.6s vs 0.85s full open). - `_indexChunk` now block-prepends (`insertAll`) instead of per-record `insert(0)` — suspended-eviction walks had made it O(n²). - Subagent registry source no longer hard-casts `_repo as JsonlSessionRepo`; foreign repos degrade to an empty registry instead of crashing. - Degradation contract preserved (F3 NEG): a genuinely corrupt session still reports inline through the picker catch; only the refusal-producing full open is gone. ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/cli/oversize_session_open_test.dart test/session/session_tree_test.dart dart test test/cli/sessions_picker_test.dart test/cli/trajectory_cli_test.dart ``` Regression runs: `test/session` (314), `test/trajectory` (197), `test/agent`+`test/hub` (548), `test/cli` (3529) all green; trajectory perf gate within budget (97 MB real CLI path, parse 791 ms / total 5.4 s). `dart analyze` clean on all touched files. ### Not in this slice (follow-ups) AC3a streaming trajectory export (exporters still snapshot-based), W2 rotation activation, W3 write-side caps (owner-call, opt-in), picker "too large to preview" badge UI, E2E/nightly oversize fixtures (AC8). Known pre-existing, reproduced on unmodified main: `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts the VM at teardown (`malloc_consolidate(): unaligned fastbin chunk`) and kills whole-directory `dart test` runs that include it — run it in isolation.
Architecture diagram ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph before [before W1] P1[Picker / resume / trajectory / child preview] --> F[repo.open full] F -->|> 2 GiB| X[SessionException tooLarge] end subgraph after [after W1] P2[Picker · /resume · name scan · child preview] --> W[repo.open windowed] T[fa trajectory view/cost/inspect] --> W W --> H[ensureWholeLedgerResident
loadAllOlder: bounded blocks, one splice] W --> N[resolveSessionName
paged name lookup] TL[fa trajectory tail] --> W end ```

# pr-1558: gh-1555 [GOAL] Session JSONL grows unboundedly past the 2 GiB full-open backstop legacy full-open call sites (picker, resume fallback, trajectory, subagent preview) make the session unopenable ## Description Closes #1555 ## gh-1555 W1 — Lazy/windowed-everywhere reads (first shippable slice) ### What changed Migrated the legacy full-open call sites (ticket mechanism d1–d7) to windowed opens so a session past the 2 GiB gh-1073 backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path. The TUI picker (the incident's exact failure path), `/resume`, boot name-resolution, subagent transcript preview, and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver now open windowed; name lookups page via `resolveSessionName()`. The `_loadSession` marathon fallback's full open (which refused past 2 GiB — the incident's broken rescue) is replaced by proceeding with the tail-anchored windowed session. Trajectory `view/cost/inspect` materialize the branch via the new `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident()` → `WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder()` (sequential bounded-block forward scan, no full-open refusal); `tail` polls stay windowed. ### Key decisions - `loadAllOlder()` (sequential strips from file head, one splice) chosen over reusing `growOlderUntil` — the boundary-walk's doubling strips + per-strip record cap amplified read/parse ~13× over a whole file (30k-record bench: 9.6s vs 0.85s full open). - `_indexChunk` now block-prepends (`insertAll`) instead of per-record `insert(0)` — suspended-eviction walks had made it O(n²). - Subagent registry source no longer hard-casts `_repo as JsonlSessionRepo`; foreign repos degrade to an empty registry instead of crashing. - Degradation contract preserved (F3 NEG): a genuinely corrupt session still reports inline through the picker catch; only the refusal-producing full open is gone. ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/cli/oversize_session_open_test.dart test/session/session_tree_test.dart dart test test/cli/sessions_picker_test.dart test/cli/trajectory_cli_test.dart ``` Regression runs: `test/session` (314), `test/trajectory` (197), `test/agent`+`test/hub` (548), `test/cli` (3529) all green; trajectory perf gate within budget (97 MB real CLI path, parse 791 ms / total 5.4 s). `dart analyze` clean on all touched files. ### Not in this slice (follow-ups) AC3a streaming trajectory export (exporters still snapshot-based), W2 rotation activation, W3 write-side caps (owner-call, opt-in), picker "too large to preview" badge UI, E2E/nightly oversize fixtures (AC8). loadAllOlder: bounded blocks, one splice] W --> N[resolveSessionName
paged name lookup] TL[fa trajectory tail] --> W end ```

# Pull Request Information - **PR #**: 1558 - **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1558 - **Title**: gh-1555 [GOAL] Session JSONL grows unboundedly past the 2 GiB full-open backstop legacy full-open call sites (picker, resume fallback, trajectory, subagent preview) make the session unopenable - **Author**: ai-teammate - **Branch**: `ai/gh-1555` → `main` - **State**: open - **Files Changed**: 14 - **Additions**: +946 - **Deletions**: -54 - **Created**: 2026-10-11T21:05:18Z - **Updated**: 2026-10-13T21:20:11Z ## PR Description Closes #1555 ## gh-1555 W1 — Lazy/windowed-everywhere reads (first shippable slice) ### What changed Migrated the legacy full-open call sites (ticket mechanism d1–d7) to windowed opens so a session past the 2 GiB gh-1073 backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path. The TUI picker (the incident's exact failure path), `/resume`, boot name-resolution, subagent transcript preview, and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver now open windowed; name lookups page via `resolveSessionName()`. The `_loadSession` marathon fallback's full open (which refused past 2 GiB — the incident's broken rescue) is replaced by proceeding with the tail-anchored windowed session. Trajectory `view/cost/inspect` materialize the branch via the new `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident()` → `WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder()` (sequential bounded-block forward scan, no full-open refusal); `tail` polls stay windowed. ### Key decisions - `loadAllOlder()` (sequential strips from file head, one splice) chosen over reusing `growOlderUntil` — the boundary-walk's doubling strips + per-strip record cap amplified read/parse ~13× over a whole file (30k-record bench: 9.6s vs 0.85s full open). - `_indexChunk` now block-prepends (`insertAll`) instead of per-record `insert(0)` — suspended-eviction walks had made it O(n²). - Subagent registry source no longer hard-casts `_repo as JsonlSessionRepo`; foreign repos degrade to an empty registry instead of crashing. - Degradation contract preserved (F3 NEG): a genuinely corrupt session still reports inline through the picker catch; only the refusal-producing full open is gone. ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/cli/oversize_session_open_test.dart test/session/session_tree_test.dart dart test test/cli/sessions_picker_test.dart test/cli/trajectory_cli_test.dart ``` Regression runs: `test/session` (314), `test/trajectory` (197), `test/agent`+`test/hub` (548), `test/cli` (3529) all green; trajectory perf gate within budget (97 MB real CLI path, parse 791 ms / total 5.4 s). `dart analyze` clean on all touched files. ### Not in this slice (follow-ups) AC3a streaming trajectory export (exporters still snapshot-based), W2 rotation activation, W3 write-side caps (owner-call, opt-in), picker "too large to preview" badge UI, E2E/nightly oversize fixtures (AC8). on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose

bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

<<<<<<< HEAD
<<<<<<< HEAD
- gh-1555 (W1, lazy/windowed-everywhere reads): the legacy full-open call
  sites migrate to windowed opens, so a session ledger past the gh-1073
  2 GiB full-open backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path.
  The TUI session picker, `/resume`, and the boot name-resolution scan
  open windowed and resolve the display name through paged reads; the
  subagent transcript preview opens the child windowed (tail only); the
  `_loadSession` marathon fallback no longer degenerates to a refused
  full open when the boundary walk exhausts its page cap (it proceeds
  with the tail-anchored windowed session; the boot cap owns over-window
  residue); and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver opens windowed,
  reading the whole ledger for the cost/inspect views through the new
  `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident` — a sequential forward scan in
  bounded strips (`WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder`), not the
  boundary-walk's doubling strips (whose per-strip record cap measured
  ~13x read/parse amplification over the whole file). The same change
  block-prepends paged chunks in `_indexChunk` (one `insertAll` per
  list), removing an O(n²) the suspended-eviction walk paid per record.
  Trajectory export streaming (AC3a), split-and-retain rotation
  activation (W2), and the opt-in write-side caps (W3) remain follow-up
  work.
=======
=======
- gh-1603: unattended runs can no longer end as a clean success on empty
  model responses. Loop: from the second empty-hiccup retry on, the request
  carries a continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was
  empty/truncated — continue the task"; exact-text constant
  `emptyContinuationNudge`, emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript
  stays truthful) — a cap-truncated reasoning model re-streamed verbatim

# Pull Request Information - **PR #**: 1558 - **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1558 - **Title**: gh-1555 [GOAL] Session JSONL grows unboundedly past the 2 GiB full-open backstop legacy full-open call sites (picker, resume fallback, trajectory, subagent preview) make the session unopenable - **Author**: ai-teammate - **Branch**: `ai/gh-1555` → `main` - **State**: open - **Files Changed**: 14 - **Additions**: +946 - **Deletions**: -54 - **Created**: 2026-10-11T21:05:18Z - **Updated**: 2026-10-13T21:20:11Z ## PR Description Closes #1555 ## gh-1555 W1 — Lazy/windowed-everywhere reads (first shippable slice) ### What changed Migrated the legacy full-open call sites (ticket mechanism d1–d7) to windowed opens so a session past the 2 GiB gh-1073 backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path. The TUI picker (the incident's exact failure path), `/resume`, boot name-resolution, subagent transcript preview, and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver now open windowed; name lookups page via `resolveSessionName()`. The `_loadSession` marathon fallback's full open (which refused past 2 GiB — the incident's broken rescue) is replaced by proceeding with the tail-anchored windowed session. Trajectory `view/cost/inspect` materialize the branch via the new `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident()` → `WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder()` (sequential bounded-block forward scan, no full-open refusal); `tail` polls stay windowed. ### Key decisions - `loadAllOlder()` (sequential strips from file head, one splice) chosen over reusing `growOlderUntil` — the boundary-walk's doubling strips + per-strip record cap amplified read/parse ~13× over a whole file (30k-record bench: 9.6s vs 0.85s full open). - `_indexChunk` now block-prepends (`insertAll`) instead of per-record `insert(0)` — suspended-eviction walks had made it O(n²). - Subagent registry source no longer hard-casts `_repo as JsonlSessionRepo`; foreign repos degrade to an empty registry instead of crashing. - Degradation contract preserved (F3 NEG): a genuinely corrupt session still reports inline through the picker catch; only the refusal-producing full open is gone. ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/cli/oversize_session_open_test.dart test/session/session_tree_test.dart dart test test/cli/sessions_picker_test.dart test/cli/trajectory_cli_test.dart ``` Regression runs: `test/session` (314), `test/trajectory` (197), `test/agent`+`test/hub` (548), `test/cli` (3529) all green; trajectory perf gate within budget (97 MB real CLI path, parse 791 ms / total 5.4 s). `dart analyze` clean on all touched files. ### Not in this slice (follow-ups) AC3a streaming trajectory export (exporters still snapshot-based), W2 rotation activation, W3 write-side caps (owner-call, opt-in), picker "too large to preview" badge UI, E2E/nightly oversize fixtures (AC8). Known pre-existing, reproduced on unmodified main: `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts the VM at teardown (`malloc_consolidate(): unaligned fastbin chunk`) and kills whole-directory `dart test` runs that include it — run it in isolation.

loadAllOlder: bounded blocks, one splice] W --> N[resolveSessionName
paged name lookup] TL[fa trajectory tail] --> W end ```

## Unreleased

- gh-1603: unattended runs can no longer end as a clean success on empty
  model responses. Loop: from the second empty-hiccup retry on, the request
  carries a continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was
  empty/truncated — continue the task"; exact-text constant
  `emptyContinuationNudge`, emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript
  stays truthful) — a cap-truncated reasoning model re-streamed verbatim
  repeats the empty outcome, the nudge breaks the symmetry; the classifier
  treats that exact message as transparent, so the turn's partial-content
  window (gh-1577) survives a nudged retry. Headless: the empty-reply nudge
  budget rises to `AgentCliConfig.headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2 — the
  session ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive
  keeps the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics), and a run that still settles
  empty prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a
  distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0.

- gh-1577: an empty assistant completion after partial content (assistant
  text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is a
  bounded-retry provider hiccup — up to `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3)
  re-streams with exponential backoff (`emptyHiccupBaseDelay`,
  `emptyHiccupMaxBackoff`, both threaded through the `Agent` facade,
  `AgentWiringSpec`, and the CLI config), and exhaustion ends the run with
  a loud `StopReason.error` (headless exit 1, interactive error + prompt)
  instead of the silent exit-0 settle that killed the gh-1577 trials.
  Clean empties keep the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics. The abort always
  wins: a cancel racing the final retry settles `StopReason.aborted` for
  any empty shape (the exit-contract race is pinned by tests), and the
  backoff sleep is cancellation-aware.

- gh-1556: bench pipeline stops bleeding score + fa deadline awareness.
  Bench: the harbor ladder kill uses the `[f]a` bracket trick and is
  wrapped so a kill failure can never replace the `TimeoutError` (the
  pre-fix self-matching `pkill` classified TB 2.0 ladder kills as agent
  crashes — a SOLVED task scored 0); progress-watch (stall-gap 360s per
  the gh-1430 watchdog invariant, flat abs ceiling 3600s) is the
  bench-harbor.yml default on every shard, with the harbor adapter
  picking the gap-aware `ProgressWatch` for parity with the
  terminal-bench adapter; the aggregate counts completeness by
  `result.json` presence (errored trials report as their own breakdown
  line; exit 1 only on genuinely lost trials) and renders the full
  report — table, errored breakdown, ledger row — to
  `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` (TB1 parity). Both bench adapters export
  `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS` (effective cap − 120s wrap-up margin) into the
  agent session and audit the exact value. fa core: deadline awareness —
  `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS` / `--timer`/`--deadline` / `/timer` write one
  session clock, the per-turn context carries a `time-left:` line while
  armed, and one-shot system notices steer wrap-up at ~50%, T-3min
  (drain background jobs), and T-30s; absent deadline = byte-for-byte
  today's behavior.

- gh-1522: tag-sourced versions — the git tag is the single source of
  truth. The release-bot file bumps are retired: cutting a release = a
  tag + GitHub Release (zero commits to main, zero file mutations).
  Both pubspecs carry the fixed `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (CI guards
  hand-bumps), the publish job stamps the staged pubspec + generated
  changelog section from the tag (`scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`,
  staged version == tag guarded pre-upload), store builds stamp
  `--build-name/--build-number` from the derived tag version
  (`pubspec.lock` stops churning across releases), and
  `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from `git describe`.

  session's model id, so every token row the factory publishes is

  stays truthful) — a cap-truncated reasoning model re-streamed verbatim
  repeats the empty outcome, the nudge breaks the symmetry; the classifier
  treats that exact message as transparent, so the turn's partial-content
  window (gh-1577) survives a nudged retry. Headless: the empty-reply nudge
  budget rises to `AgentCliConfig.headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2 — the
  session ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive
  keeps the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics), and a run that still settles
  empty prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a
  distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0.

- gh-1577: an empty assistant completion after partial content (assistant
  text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is a
  bounded-retry provider hiccup — up to `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3)
  re-streams with exponential backoff (`emptyHiccupBaseDelay`,
  `emptyHiccupMaxBackoff`, both threaded through the `Agent` facade,
  `AgentWiringSpec`, and the CLI config), and exhaustion ends the run with
  a loud `StopReason.error` (headless exit 1, interactive error + prompt)
  instead of the silent exit-0 settle that killed the gh-1577 trials.
  Clean empties keep the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics. The abort always

  `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS` / `--timer`/`--deadline` / `/timer` write one
  session clock, the per-turn context carries a `time-left:` line while
  armed, and one-shot system notices steer wrap-up at ~50%, T-3min
  (drain background jobs), and T-30s; absent deadline = byte-for-byte
  today's behavior.

- gh-1522: tag-sourced versions — the git tag is the single source of
  truth. The release-bot file bumps are retired: cutting a release = a

  `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from `git describe`.

# Pull Request Information - **PR #**: 1558 - **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1558 - **Title**: gh-1555 [GOAL] Session JSONL grows unboundedly past the 2 GiB full-open backstop legacy full-open call sites (picker, resume fallback, trajectory, subagent preview) make the session unopenable - **Author**: ai-teammate - **Branch**: `ai/gh-1555` → `main` - **State**: open - **Files Changed**: 14 - **Additions**: +946 - **Deletions**: -54 - **Created**: 2026-10-11T21:05:18Z - **Updated**: 2026-10-13T21:20:11Z ## PR Description Closes #1555 ## gh-1555 W1 — Lazy/windowed-everywhere reads (first shippable slice) ### What changed Migrated the legacy full-open call sites (ticket mechanism d1–d7) to windowed opens so a session past the 2 GiB gh-1073 backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path. The TUI picker (the incident's exact failure path), `/resume`, boot name-resolution, subagent transcript preview, and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver now open windowed; name lookups page via `resolveSessionName()`. The `_loadSession` marathon fallback's full open (which refused past 2 GiB — the incident's broken rescue) is replaced by proceeding with the tail-anchored windowed session. Trajectory `view/cost/inspect` materialize the branch via the new `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident()` → `WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder()` (sequential bounded-block forward scan, no full-open refusal); `tail` polls stay windowed. ### Key decisions - `loadAllOlder()` (sequential strips from file head, one splice) chosen over reusing `growOlderUntil` — the boundary-walk's doubling strips + per-strip record cap amplified read/parse ~13× over a whole file (30k-record bench: 9.6s vs 0.85s full open). - `_indexChunk` now block-prepends (`insertAll`) instead of per-record `insert(0)` — suspended-eviction walks had made it O(n²). - Subagent registry source no longer hard-casts `_repo as JsonlSessionRepo`; foreign repos degrade to an empty registry instead of crashing. - Degradation contract preserved (F3 NEG): a genuinely corrupt session still reports inline through the picker catch; only the refusal-producing full open is gone. ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/cli/oversize_session_open_test.dart test/session/session_tree_test.dart dart test test/cli/sessions_picker_test.dart test/cli/trajectory_cli_test.dart ``` Regression runs: `test/session` (314), `test/trajectory` (197), `test/agent`+`test/hub` (548), `test/cli` (3529) all green; trajectory perf gate within budget (97 MB real CLI path, parse 791 ms / total 5.4 s). `dart analyze` clean on all touched files. ### Not in this slice (follow-ups) AC3a streaming trajectory export (exporters still snapshot-based), W2 rotation activation, W3 write-side caps (owner-call, opt-in), picker "too large to preview" badge UI, E2E/nightly oversize fixtures (AC8). Known pre-existing, reproduced on unmodified main: `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts the VM at teardown (`malloc_consolidate(): unaligned fastbin chunk`) and kills whole-directory `dart test` runs that include it — run it in isolation.

loadAllOlder: bounded blocks, one splice] W --> N[resolveSessionName
paged name lookup] TL[fa trajectory tail] --> W end ```

# pr-1558: gh-1555 [GOAL] Session JSONL grows unboundedly past the 2 GiB full-open backstop legacy full-open call sites (picker, resume fallback, trajectory, subagent preview) make the session unopenable ## Description Closes #1555 ## gh-1555 W1 — Lazy/windowed-everywhere reads (first shippable slice) ### What changed Migrated the legacy full-open call sites (ticket mechanism d1–d7) to windowed opens so a session past the 2 GiB gh-1073 backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path. The TUI picker (the incident's exact failure path), `/resume`, boot name-resolution, subagent transcript preview, and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver now open windowed; name lookups page via `resolveSessionName()`. Trajectory `view/cost/inspect` materialize the branch via the new `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident()` → `WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder()` (sequential bounded-block forward scan, no full-open refusal); `tail` polls stay windowed. ### Key decisions - `loadAllOlder()` (sequential strips from file head, one splice) chosen over reusing `growOlderUntil` — the boundary-walk's doubling strips + per-strip record cap amplified read/parse ~13× over a whole file (30k-record bench: 9.6s vs 0.85s full open). - `_indexChunk` now block-prepends (`insertAll`) instead of per-record `insert(0)` — suspended-eviction walks had made it O(n²). - Subagent registry source no longer hard-casts `_repo as JsonlSessionRepo`; foreign repos degrade to an empty registry instead of crashing. - Degradation contract preserved (F3 NEG): a genuinely corrupt session still reports inline through the picker catch; only the refusal-producing full open is gone. ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/cli/oversize_session_open_test.dart test/session/session_tree_test.dart dart test test/cli/sessions_picker_test.dart test/cli/trajectory_cli_test.dart ``` Regression runs: `test/session` (314), `test/trajectory` (197), `test/agent`+`test/hub` (548), `test/cli` (3529) all green; trajectory perf gate within budget (97 MB real CLI path, parse 791 ms / total 5.4 s). `dart analyze` clean on all touched files. ### Not in this slice (follow-ups) AC3a streaming trajectory export (exporters still snapshot-based), W2 rotation activation, W3 write-side caps (owner-call, opt-in), picker "too large to preview" badge UI, E2E/nightly oversize fixtures (AC8). loadAllOlder: bounded blocks, one splice] W --> N[resolveSessionName
paged name lookup] TL[fa trajectory tail] --> W end ```

  session ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive
  keeps the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics), and a run that still settles
  empty prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a
  distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0.

  text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is a

  (drain background jobs), and T-30s; absent deadline = byte-for-byte
  today's behavior.

The TUI picker (the incident's exact failure path), `/resume`, boot name-resolution, subagent transcript preview, and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver now open windowed; name lookups page via `resolveSessionName()`. The `_loadSession` marathon fallback's full open (which refused past 2 GiB — the incident's broken rescue) is replaced by proceeding with the tail-anchored windowed session. Trajectory `view/cost/inspect` materialize the branch via the new `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident()` → `WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder()` (sequential bounded-block forward scan, no full-open refusal); `tail` polls stay windowed. ### Key decisions - `loadAllOlder()` (sequential strips from file head, one splice) chosen over reusing `growOlderUntil` — the boundary-walk's doubling strips + per-strip record cap amplified read/parse ~13× over a whole file (30k-record bench: 9.6s vs 0.85s full open). - `_indexChunk` now block-prepends (`insertAll`) instead of per-record `insert(0)` — suspended-eviction walks had made it O(n²). - Subagent registry source no longer hard-casts `_repo as JsonlSessionRepo`; foreign repos degrade to an empty registry instead of crashing. - Degradation contract preserved (F3 NEG): a genuinely corrupt session still reports inline through the picker catch; only the refusal-producing full open is gone. ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/cli/oversize_session_open_test.dart test/session/session_tree_test.dart dart test test/cli/sessions_picker_test.dart test/cli/trajectory_cli_test.dart ``` Regression runs: `test/session` (314), `test/trajectory` (197), `test/agent`+`test/hub` (548), `test/cli` (3529) all green; trajectory perf gate within budget (97 MB real CLI path, parse 791 ms / total 5.4 s). `dart analyze` clean on all touched files. ### Not in this slice (follow-ups) AC3a streaming trajectory export (exporters still snapshot-based), W2 rotation activation, W3 write-side caps (owner-call, opt-in), picker "too large to preview" badge UI, E2E/nightly oversize fixtures (AC8). loadAllOlder: bounded blocks, one splice] W --> N[resolveSessionName
paged name lookup] TL[fa trajectory tail] --> W end ```

## Unreleased

- gh-1603: unattended runs can no longer end as a clean success on empty
  model responses. Loop: from the second empty-hiccup retry on, the request
  carries a continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was
  empty/truncated — continue the task"; exact-text constant
  `emptyContinuationNudge`, emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript
  stays truthful) — a cap-truncated reasoning model re-streamed verbatim
  repeats the empty outcome, the nudge breaks the symmetry; the classifier
  treats that exact message as transparent, so the turn's partial-content
  window (gh-1577) survives a nudged retry. Headless: the empty-reply nudge
  budget rises to `AgentCliConfig.headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2 — the
  session ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive
  keeps the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics), and a run that still settles
  empty prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a
  distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0.

- gh-1577: an empty assistant completion after partial content (assistant
  text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is a
  bounded-retry provider hiccup — up to `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3)
  re-streams with exponential backoff (`emptyHiccupBaseDelay`,
  `emptyHiccupMaxBackoff`, both threaded through the `Agent` facade,
  `AgentWiringSpec`, and the CLI config), and exhaustion ends the run with
  a loud `StopReason.error` (headless exit 1, interactive error + prompt)
  instead of the silent exit-0 settle that killed the gh-1577 trials.
  Clean empties keep the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics. The abort always
  wins: a cancel racing the final retry settles `StopReason.aborted` for
  any empty shape (the exit-contract race is pinned by tests), and the
  backoff sleep is cancellation-aware.

- gh-1556: bench pipeline stops bleeding score + fa deadline awareness.
  Bench: the harbor ladder kill uses the `[f]a` bracket trick and is
  wrapped so a kill failure can never replace the `TimeoutError` (the
  pre-fix self-matching `pkill` classified TB 2.0 ladder kills as agent
  crashes — a SOLVED task scored 0); progress-watch (stall-gap 360s per
  the gh-1430 watchdog invariant, flat abs ceiling 3600s) is the
  bench-harbor.yml default on every shard, with the harbor adapter
  picking the gap-aware `ProgressWatch` for parity with the
  terminal-bench adapter; the aggregate counts completeness by
  `result.json` presence (errored trials report as their own breakdown
  line; exit 1 only on genuinely lost trials) and renders the full
  report — table, errored breakdown, ledger row — to
  `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` (TB1 parity). Both bench adapters export
  `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS` (effective cap − 120s wrap-up margin) into the
  agent session and audit the exact value. fa core: deadline awareness —
  `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS` / `--timer`/`--deadline` / `/timer` write one
  session clock, the per-turn context carries a `time-left:` line while
  armed, and one-shot system notices steer wrap-up at ~50%, T-3min
  (drain background jobs), and T-30s; absent deadline = byte-for-byte
  today's behavior.

- gh-1522: tag-sourced versions — the git tag is the single source of
  truth. The release-bot file bumps are retired: cutting a release = a
  tag + GitHub Release (zero commits to main, zero file mutations).
  Both pubspecs carry the fixed `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (CI guards
  hand-bumps), the publish job stamps the staged pubspec + generated
  changelog section from the tag (`scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`,
  staged version == tag guarded pre-upload), store builds stamp
  `--build-name/--build-number` from the derived tag version
  (`pubspec.lock` stops churning across releases), and
  `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from `git describe`.

  session's model id, so every token row the factory publishes is
  attributable to a model and therefore priceable. The fold now captures

The TUI picker (the incident's exact failure path), `/resume`, boot name-resolution, subagent transcript preview, and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver now open windowed; name lookups page via `resolveSessionName()`. The `_loadSession` marathon fallback's full open (which refused past 2 GiB — the incident's broken rescue) is replaced by proceeding with the tail-anchored windowed session. Trajectory `view/cost/inspect` materialize the branch via the new `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident()` → `WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder()` (sequential bounded-block forward scan, no full-open refusal); `tail` polls stay windowed. ### Key decisions - `loadAllOlder()` (sequential strips from file head, one splice) chosen over reusing `growOlderUntil` — the boundary-walk's doubling strips + per-strip record cap amplified read/parse ~13× over a whole file (30k-record bench: 9.6s vs 0.85s full open). - `_indexChunk` now block-prepends (`insertAll`) instead of per-record `insert(0)` — suspended-eviction walks had made it O(n²). - Subagent registry source no longer hard-casts `_repo as JsonlSessionRepo`; foreign repos degrade to an empty registry instead of crashing. - Degradation contract preserved (F3 NEG): a genuinely corrupt session still reports inline through the picker catch; only the refusal-producing full open is gone. ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/cli/oversize_session_open_test.dart test/session/session_tree_test.dart dart test test/cli/sessions_picker_test.dart test/cli/trajectory_cli_test.dart ``` Regression runs: `test/session` (314), `test/trajectory` (197), `test/agent`+`test/hub` (548), `test/cli` (3529) all green; trajectory perf gate within budget (97 MB real CLI path, parse 791 ms / total 5.4 s). `dart analyze` clean on all touched files. ### Not in this slice (follow-ups) AC3a streaming trajectory export (exporters still snapshot-based), W2 rotation activation, W3 write-side caps (owner-call, opt-in), picker "too large to preview" badge UI, E2E/nightly oversize fixtures (AC8). # pr-1558: gh-1555 [GOAL] Session JSONL grows unboundedly past the 2 GiB full-open backstop legacy full-open call sites (picker, resume fallback, trajectory, subagent preview) make the session unopenable ## Description Closes #1555 ## gh-1555 W1 — Lazy/windowed-everywhere reads (first shippable slice) ### What changed Migrated the legacy full-open call sites (ticket mechanism d1–d7) to windowed opens so a session past the 2 GiB gh-1073 backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path. The TUI picker (the incident's exact failure path), `/resume`, boot name-resolution, subagent transcript preview, and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver now open windowed; name lookups page via `resolveSessionName()`. The `_loadSession` marathon fallback's full open (which refused past 2 GiB — the incident's broken rescue) is replaced by proceeding with the tail-anchored windowed session. Trajectory `view/cost/inspect` materialize the branch via the new `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident()` → `WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder()` (sequential bounded-block forward scan, no full-open refusal); `tail` polls stay windowed. ### Key decisions - `loadAllOlder()` (sequential strips from file head, one splice) chosen over reusing `growOlderUntil` — the boundary-walk's doubling strips + per-strip record cap amplified read/parse ~13× over a whole file (30k-record bench: 9.6s vs 0.85s full open). - `_indexChunk` now block-prepends (`insertAll`) instead of per-record `insert(0)` — suspended-eviction walks had made it O(n²). - Subagent registry source no longer hard-casts `_repo as JsonlSessionRepo`; foreign repos degrade to an empty registry instead of crashing. - Degradation contract preserved (F3 NEG): a genuinely corrupt session still reports inline through the picker catch; only the refusal-producing full open is gone. ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/cli/oversize_session_open_test.dart test/session/session_tree_test.dart dart test test/cli/sessions_picker_test.dart test/cli/trajectory_cli_test.dart ``` Regression runs: `test/session` (314), `test/trajectory` (197), `test/agent`+`test/hub` (548), `test/cli` (3529) all green; trajectory perf gate within budget (97 MB real CLI path, parse 791 ms / total 5.4 s). `dart analyze` clean on all touched files. ### Not in this slice (follow-ups) AC3a streaming trajectory export (exporters still snapshot-based), W2 rotation activation, W3 write-side caps (owner-call, opt-in), picker "too large to preview" badge UI, E2E/nightly oversize fixtures (AC8). loadAllOlder: bounded blocks, one splice] W --> N[resolveSessionName
paged name lookup] TL[fa trajectory tail] --> W end ```

  stays truthful) — a cap-truncated reasoning model re-streamed verbatim

  treats that exact message as transparent, so the turn's partial-content
  window (gh-1577) survives a nudged retry. Headless: the empty-reply nudge
  budget rises to `AgentCliConfig.headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2 — the
  session ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive
  keeps the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics), and a run that still settles
  empty prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a
  distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0.

- gh-1577: an empty assistant completion after partial content (assistant
  text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is a
  bounded-retry provider hiccup — up to `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3)

  `emptyHiccupMaxBackoff`, both threaded through the `Agent` facade,
  `AgentWiringSpec`, and the CLI config), and exhaustion ends the run with

  today's behavior.

# Pull Request Information - **PR #**: 1558 - **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1558 - **Title**: gh-1555 [GOAL] Session JSONL grows unboundedly past the 2 GiB full-open backstop legacy full-open call sites (picker, resume fallback, trajectory, subagent preview) make the session unopenable - **Author**: ai-teammate - **Branch**: `ai/gh-1555` → `main` - **State**: open - **Files Changed**: 14 - **Additions**: +946 - **Deletions**: -54 - **Created**: 2026-10-11T21:05:18Z - **Updated**: 2026-10-13T21:20:11Z ## PR Description Closes #1555 ## gh-1555 W1 — Lazy/windowed-everywhere reads (first shippable slice) ### What changed Migrated the legacy full-open call sites (ticket mechanism d1–d7) to windowed opens so a session past the 2 GiB gh-1073 backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path. The TUI picker (the incident's exact failure path), `/resume`, boot name-resolution, subagent transcript preview, and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver now open windowed; name lookups page via `resolveSessionName()`. The `_loadSession` marathon fallback's full open (which refused past 2 GiB — the incident's broken rescue) is replaced by proceeding with the tail-anchored windowed session. Trajectory `view/cost/inspect` materialize the branch via the new `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident()` → `WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder()` (sequential bounded-block forward scan, no full-open refusal); `tail` polls stay windowed. ### Key decisions - `loadAllOlder()` (sequential strips from file head, one splice) chosen over reusing `growOlderUntil` — the boundary-walk's doubling strips + per-strip record cap amplified read/parse ~13× over a whole file (30k-record bench: 9.6s vs 0.85s full open). - `_indexChunk` now block-prepends (`insertAll`) instead of per-record `insert(0)` — suspended-eviction walks had made it O(n²). - Subagent registry source no longer hard-casts `_repo as JsonlSessionRepo`; foreign repos degrade to an empty registry instead of crashing. - Degradation contract preserved (F3 NEG): a genuinely corrupt session still reports inline through the picker catch; only the refusal-producing full open is gone. ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/cli/oversize_session_open_test.dart test/session/session_tree_test.dart dart test test/cli/sessions_picker_test.dart test/cli/trajectory_cli_test.dart ``` Regression runs: `test/session` (314), `test/trajectory` (197), `test/agent`+`test/hub` (548), `test/cli` (3529) all green; trajectory perf gate within budget (97 MB real CLI path, parse 791 ms / total 5.4 s). `dart analyze` clean on all touched files. ### Not in this slice (follow-ups) AC3a streaming trajectory export (exporters still snapshot-based), W2 rotation activation, W3 write-side caps (owner-call, opt-in), picker "too large to preview" badge UI, E2E/nightly oversize fixtures (AC8). Known pre-existing, reproduced on unmodified main: `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts the VM at teardown (`malloc_consolidate(): unaligned fastbin chunk`) and kills whole-directory `dart test` runs that include it — run it in isolation.
Architecture diagram ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph before [before W1] P1[Picker / resume / trajectory / child preview] --> F[repo.open full] F -->|> 2 GiB| X[SessionException tooLarge] end subgraph after [after W1] P2[Picker · /resume · name scan · child preview] --> W[repo.open windowed] T[fa trajectory view/cost/inspect] --> W W --> H[ensureWholeLedgerResident
loadAllOlder: bounded blocks, one splice] W --> N[resolveSessionName
paged name lookup] TL[fa trajectory tail] --> W end ```

## Unreleased

- gh-1603: unattended runs can no longer end as a clean success on empty
  model responses. Loop: from the second empty-hiccup retry on, the request
  carries a continuation nudge user message ("your last reply was
  empty/truncated — continue the task"; exact-text constant
  `emptyContinuationNudge`, emitted with MessageStart/End so the transcript
  stays truthful) — a cap-truncated reasoning model re-streamed verbatim
  repeats the empty outcome, the nudge breaks the symmetry; the classifier
  treats that exact message as transparent, so the turn's partial-content
  window (gh-1577) survives a nudged retry. Headless: the empty-reply nudge
  budget rises to `AgentCliConfig.headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2 — the
  session ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive
  keeps the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics), and a run that still settles
  empty prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a
  distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0.

- gh-1577: an empty assistant completion after partial content (assistant
  text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is a
  bounded-retry provider hiccup — up to `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3)
  re-streams with exponential backoff (`emptyHiccupBaseDelay`,
  `emptyHiccupMaxBackoff`, both threaded through the `Agent` facade,
  `AgentWiringSpec`, and the CLI config), and exhaustion ends the run with
  a loud `StopReason.error` (headless exit 1, interactive error + prompt)
  instead of the silent exit-0 settle that killed the gh-1577 trials.
  Clean empties keep the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics. The abort always
  wins: a cancel racing the final retry settles `StopReason.aborted` for
  any empty shape (the exit-contract race is pinned by tests), and the
  backoff sleep is cancellation-aware.

- gh-1556: bench pipeline stops bleeding score + fa deadline awareness.
  Bench: the harbor ladder kill uses the `[f]a` bracket trick and is
  wrapped so a kill failure can never replace the `TimeoutError` (the
  pre-fix self-matching `pkill` classified TB 2.0 ladder kills as agent
  crashes — a SOLVED task scored 0); progress-watch (stall-gap 360s per
  the gh-1430 watchdog invariant, flat abs ceiling 3600s) is the
  bench-harbor.yml default on every shard, with the harbor adapter
  picking the gap-aware `ProgressWatch` for parity with the
  terminal-bench adapter; the aggregate counts completeness by
  `result.json` presence (errored trials report as their own breakdown
  line; exit 1 only on genuinely lost trials) and renders the full
  report — table, errored breakdown, ledger row — to
  `$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY` (TB1 parity). Both bench adapters export
  `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS` (effective cap − 120s wrap-up margin) into the
  agent session and audit the exact value. fa core: deadline awareness —
  `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS` / `--timer`/`--deadline` / `/timer` write one
  session clock, the per-turn context carries a `time-left:` line while
  armed, and one-shot system notices steer wrap-up at ~50%, T-3min
  (drain background jobs), and T-30s; absent deadline = byte-for-byte
  today's behavior.

- gh-1522: tag-sourced versions — the git tag is the single source of
  truth. The release-bot file bumps are retired: cutting a release = a
  tag + GitHub Release (zero commits to main, zero file mutations).
  Both pubspecs carry the fixed `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (CI guards
  hand-bumps), the publish job stamps the staged pubspec + generated
  changelog section from the tag (`scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`,
  staged version == tag guarded pre-upload), store builds stamp
  `--build-name/--build-number` from the derived tag version
  (`pubspec.lock` stops churning across releases), and
  `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from `git describe`.

# Pull Request Information - **PR #**: 1558 - **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1558 - **Title**: gh-1555 [GOAL] Session JSONL grows unboundedly past the 2 GiB full-open backstop legacy full-open call sites (picker, resume fallback, trajectory, subagent preview) make the session unopenable - **Author**: ai-teammate - **Branch**: `ai/gh-1555` → `main` - **State**: open - **Files Changed**: 14 - **Additions**: +946 - **Deletions**: -54 - **Created**: 2026-10-11T21:05:18Z - **Updated**: 2026-10-13T21:20:11Z ## PR Description Closes #1555 ## gh-1555 W1 — Lazy/windowed-everywhere reads (first shippable slice) ### What changed Migrated the legacy full-open call sites (ticket mechanism d1–d7) to windowed opens so a session past the 2 GiB gh-1073 backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path. The TUI picker (the incident's exact failure path), `/resume`, boot name-resolution, subagent transcript preview, and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver now open windowed; name lookups page via `resolveSessionName()`. The `_loadSession` marathon fallback's full open (which refused past 2 GiB — the incident's broken rescue) is replaced by proceeding with the tail-anchored windowed session. Trajectory `view/cost/inspect` materialize the branch via the new `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident()` → `WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder()` (sequential bounded-block forward scan, no full-open refusal); `tail` polls stay windowed. ### Key decisions - `loadAllOlder()` (sequential strips from file head, one splice) chosen over reusing `growOlderUntil` — the boundary-walk's doubling strips + per-strip record cap amplified read/parse ~13× over a whole file (30k-record bench: 9.6s vs 0.85s full open). - `_indexChunk` now block-prepends (`insertAll`) instead of per-record `insert(0)` — suspended-eviction walks had made it O(n²). - Subagent registry source no longer hard-casts `_repo as JsonlSessionRepo`; foreign repos degrade to an empty registry instead of crashing. - Degradation contract preserved (F3 NEG): a genuinely corrupt session still reports inline through the picker catch; only the refusal-producing full open is gone. ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/cli/oversize_session_open_test.dart test/session/session_tree_test.dart dart test test/cli/sessions_picker_test.dart test/cli/trajectory_cli_test.dart ``` Regression runs: `test/session` (314), `test/trajectory` (197), `test/agent`+`test/hub` (548), `test/cli` (3529) all green; trajectory perf gate within budget (97 MB real CLI path, parse 791 ms / total 5.4 s). `dart analyze` clean on all touched files. ### Not in this slice (follow-ups) AC3a streaming trajectory export (exporters still snapshot-based), W2 rotation activation, W3 write-side caps (owner-call, opt-in), picker "too large to preview" badge UI, E2E/nightly oversize fixtures (AC8). Known pre-existing, reproduced on unmodified main: `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts the VM at teardown (`malloc_consolidate(): unaligned fastbin chunk`) and kills whole-directory `dart test` runs that include it — run it in isolation.
Architecture diagram ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph before [before W1] P1[Picker / resume / trajectory / child preview] --> F[repo.open full] F -->|> 2 GiB| X[SessionException tooLarge] end subgraph after [after W1] P2[Picker · /resume · name scan · child preview] --> W[repo.open windowed] T[fa trajectory view/cost/inspect] --> W W --> H[ensureWholeLedgerResident
loadAllOlder: bounded blocks, one splice] W --> N[resolveSessionName
paged name lookup] TL[fa trajectory tail] --> W end ```

# pr-1558: gh-1555 [GOAL] Session JSONL grows unboundedly past the 2 GiB full-open backstop legacy full-open call sites (picker, resume fallback, trajectory, subagent preview) make the session unopenable ## Description Closes #1555 ## gh-1555 W1 — Lazy/windowed-everywhere reads (first shippable slice) ### What changed Migrated the legacy full-open call sites (ticket mechanism d1–d7) to windowed opens so a session past the 2 GiB gh-1073 backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path. loadAllOlder: bounded blocks, one splice] W --> N[resolveSessionName
paged name lookup] TL[fa trajectory tail] --> W end ```

# Pull Request Information - **PR #**: 1558 - **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1558 - **Title**: gh-1555 [GOAL] Session JSONL grows unboundedly past the 2 GiB full-open backstop legacy full-open call sites (picker, resume fallback, trajectory, subagent preview) make the session unopenable - **Author**: ai-teammate - **Branch**: `ai/gh-1555` → `main` - **State**: open - **Files Changed**: 14 - **Additions**: +946 - **Deletions**: -54 - **Created**: 2026-10-11T21:05:18Z - **Updated**: 2026-10-13T21:20:11Z ## PR Description Closes #1555 ## gh-1555 W1 — Lazy/windowed-everywhere reads (first shippable slice) ### What changed Migrated the legacy full-open call sites (ticket mechanism d1–d7) to windowed opens so a session past the 2 GiB gh-1073 backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path. The TUI picker (the incident's exact failure path), `/resume`, boot name-resolution, subagent transcript preview, and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver now open windowed; name lookups page via `resolveSessionName()`. The `_loadSession` marathon fallback's full open (which refused past 2 GiB — the incident's broken rescue) is replaced by proceeding with the tail-anchored windowed session.   treats that exact message as transparent, so the turn's partial-content
  window (gh-1577) survives a nudged retry. Headless: the empty-reply nudge
  budget rises to `AgentCliConfig.headlessEmptyReplyNudges` (default 2 — the
  session ends only after 3 consecutive unrecoverable empties; interactive
  keeps the #1085 M2b one-nudge semantics), and a run that still settles
  empty prints the explicit `__FA_INCOMPLETE` marker and exits 1 — a
  distinguishable failure for the bench adapter, never a silent exit 0.

- gh-1577: an empty assistant completion after partial content (assistant
  text, tool activity, or a truncation signal earlier in the turn) is a
  bounded-retry provider hiccup — up to `emptyHiccupRetries` (default 3)
  re-streams with exponential backoff (`emptyHiccupBaseDelay`,
  `emptyHiccupMaxBackoff`, both threaded through the `Agent` facade,
  `AgentWiringSpec`, and the CLI config), and exhaustion ends the run with

  instead of the silent exit-0 settle that killed the gh-1577 trials.

  `FA_DEADLINE_EPOCH_MS` / `--timer`/`--deadline` / `/timer` write one
  session clock, the per-turn context carries a `time-left:` line while
  armed, and one-shot system notices steer wrap-up at ~50%, T-3min
  (drain background jobs), and T-30s; absent deadline = byte-for-byte
  today's behavior.

- gh-1522: tag-sourced versions — the git tag is the single source of
  truth. The release-bot file bumps are retired: cutting a release = a

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

# Pull Request Information - **PR #**: 1558 - **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1558 - **Title**: gh-1555 [GOAL] Session JSONL grows unboundedly past the 2 GiB full-open backstop legacy full-open call sites (picker, resume fallback, trajectory, subagent preview) make the session unopenable - **Author**: ai-teammate - **Branch**: `ai/gh-1555` → `main` - **State**: open - **Files Changed**: 14 - **Additions**: +946 - **Deletions**: -54 - **Created**: 2026-10-11T21:05:18Z - **Updated**: 2026-10-13T21:20:11Z ## PR Description Closes #1555 ## gh-1555 W1 — Lazy/windowed-everywhere reads (first shippable slice) ### What changed Migrated the legacy full-open call sites (ticket mechanism d1–d7) to windowed opens so a session past the 2 GiB gh-1073 backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path. The TUI picker (the incident's exact failure path), `/resume`, boot name-resolution, subagent transcript preview, and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver now open windowed; name lookups page via `resolveSessionName()`. The `_loadSession` marathon fallback's full open (which refused past 2 GiB — the incident's broken rescue) is replaced by proceeding with the tail-anchored windowed session. Trajectory `view/cost/inspect` materialize the branch via the new `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident()` → `WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder()` (sequential bounded-block forward scan, no full-open refusal); `tail` polls stay windowed. ### Key decisions - `loadAllOlder()` (sequential strips from file head, one splice) chosen over reusing `growOlderUntil` — the boundary-walk's doubling strips + per-strip record cap amplified read/parse ~13× over a whole file (30k-record bench: 9.6s vs 0.85s full open). - `_indexChunk` now block-prepends (`insertAll`) instead of per-record `insert(0)` — suspended-eviction walks had made it O(n²). - Subagent registry source no longer hard-casts `_repo as JsonlSessionRepo`; foreign repos degrade to an empty registry instead of crashing. - Degradation contract preserved (F3 NEG): a genuinely corrupt session still reports inline through the picker catch; only the refusal-producing full open is gone. ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/cli/oversize_session_open_test.dart test/session/session_tree_test.dart dart test test/cli/sessions_picker_test.dart test/cli/trajectory_cli_test.dart ``` Regression runs: `test/session` (314), `test/trajectory` (197), `test/agent`+`test/hub` (548), `test/cli` (3529) all green; trajectory perf gate within budget (97 MB real CLI path, parse 791 ms / total 5.4 s). `dart analyze` clean on all touched files. ### Not in this slice (follow-ups) AC3a streaming trajectory export (exporters still snapshot-based), W2 rotation activation, W3 write-side caps (owner-call, opt-in), picker "too large to preview" badge UI, E2E/nightly oversize fixtures (AC8). Known pre-existing, reproduced on unmodified main: `test/cli/tui_prototype_snapshot_test.dart` aborts the VM at teardown (`malloc_consolidate(): unaligned fastbin chunk`) and kills whole-directory `dart test` runs that include it — run it in isolation.
Architecture diagram ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph before [before W1] P1[Picker / resume / trajectory / child preview] --> F[repo.open full] F -->|> 2 GiB| X[SessionException tooLarge] end subgraph after [after W1] P2[Picker · /resume · name scan · child preview] --> W[repo.open windowed] T[fa trajectory view/cost/inspect] --> W W --> H[ensureWholeLedgerResident
loadAllOlder: bounded blocks, one splice] W --> N[resolveSessionName
paged name lookup] TL[fa trajectory tail] --> W end ```

# pr-1558: gh-1555 [GOAL] Session JSONL grows unboundedly past the 2 GiB full-open backstop legacy full-open call sites (picker, resume fallback, trajectory, subagent preview) make the session unopenable ## Description Closes #1555 ## gh-1555 W1 — Lazy/windowed-everywhere reads (first shippable slice) ### What changed Migrated the legacy full-open call sites (ticket mechanism d1–d7) to windowed opens so a session past the 2 GiB gh-1073 backstop stays openable on every user-facing read path. The TUI picker (the incident's exact failure path), `/resume`, boot name-resolution, subagent transcript preview, and the headless `fa trajectory` resolver now open windowed; name lookups page via `resolveSessionName()`. The `_loadSession` marathon fallback's full open (which refused past 2 GiB — the incident's broken rescue) is replaced by proceeding with the tail-anchored windowed session. Trajectory `view/cost/inspect` materialize the branch via the new `SessionTree.ensureWholeLedgerResident()` → `WindowedSessionStorage.loadAllOlder()` (sequential bounded-block forward scan, no full-open refusal); `tail` polls stay windowed. ### Key decisions - `loadAllOlder()` (sequential strips from file head, one splice) chosen over reusing `growOlderUntil` — the boundary-walk's doubling strips + per-strip record cap amplified read/parse ~13× over a whole file (30k-record bench: 9.6s vs 0.85s full open). - `_indexChunk` now block-prepends (`insertAll`) instead of per-record `insert(0)` — suspended-eviction walks had made it O(n²). - Subagent registry source no longer hard-casts `_repo as JsonlSessionRepo`; foreign repos degrade to an empty registry instead of crashing. - Degradation contract preserved (F3 NEG): a genuinely corrupt session still reports inline through the picker catch; only the refusal-producing full open is gone. ### How to verify ```bash dart test test/cli/oversize_session_open_test.dart test/session/session_tree_test.dart dart test test/cli/sessions_picker_test.dart test/cli/trajectory_cli_test.dart ``` Regression runs: `test/session` (314), `test/trajectory` (197), `test/agent`+`test/hub` (548), `test/cli` (3529) all green; trajectory perf gate within budget (97 MB real CLI path, parse 791 ms / total 5.4 s). `dart analyze` clean on all touched files. ### Not in this slice (follow-ups) AC3a streaming trajectory export (exporters still snapshot-based), W2 rotation activation, W3 write-side caps (owner-call, opt-in), picker "too large to preview" badge UI, E2E/nightly oversize fixtures (AC8). loadAllOlder: bounded blocks, one splice] W --> N[resolveSessionName
paged name lookup] TL[fa trajectory tail] --> W end ```

blocks.text:
# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
